Windows integration, real music files and a first-run guide.

### New
- **Windows media controls**: the media panel next to the volume popup and the lock screen show what is playing, and keyboard and headset media keys (play/pause, next, previous) control Lindale
- **Downloads are normal music files**: saved as "Artist - Title" in your **Music\Lindale** folder, so Explorer and other players see them. Songs you downloaded before move there on first start
- **Welcome guide** on first start: sign in, bring your playlists from Spotify (via Exportify), handy keys
- **Import from other apps** in Settings > Backup & Restore: Spotify (Exportify CSV), M3U playlists (foobar2000, VLC, Winamp, iTunes, MusicBee) and other CSV exports

### Improved
- **Privacy**: "Disable screenshot" now really hides the window from screenshots, recordings and screen sharing (Discord, Teams, OBS)
- **Storage** shows your downloads (count, size, folder); the song-cache section that did nothing on Windows is gone
- **Appearance** only lists settings that work on Windows, with short explanations
- **Integrations** (Discord, Last.fm) moved to the Account page
- Search suggestions now appear over the full-screen player

### Install
Download **Lindale-setup.exe** below and run it (it updates an existing install). SmartScreen may warn because the installer is not signed yet: **More info → Run anyway**. Or use **Lindale-portable.zip**.
